annotations.title: Get a link to a company page on the website

description: A link the signed-in customer clicks to act on one of their companies on the firm's website: "signing" to sign documents, "verification" for identity verification, "annual_return" to approve the annual return, "invoices" to see and pay invoices. get_company's needs_you says which apply. Signing, payment and approvals never happen in chat.
name: create_company_link
